read.detail: rows: ERROR 1064 (HY000) at line 1: Failed to open the off-heap table scanner. java exception details: java.io.IOException: Failed to open the paimon reader for table t_pk
read.reason: StarRocks 4.1.6 reads with short-lived S3 credentials of its own (UAT-CMP-08), and its JNI reader, which takes the primary-key table's splits that need a merge, fails the first such read after its BE starts, and can fail it after the catalog gets new credentials ('Provider TemporaryAWSCredentialsProvider has no credentials'); later reads pass. The cause is upstream (StarRocks/starrocks#81984): StarRocks 4.1.6 bundles paimon-s3 1.3.1, which carries Hadoop 3.3.4, whose TemporaryAWSCredentialsProvider gives no credentials to the calls made while its first call is still loading them (HADOOP-18233, fixed in Hadoop 3.3.5), and the BE's scanners share one cached S3AFileSystem. Measured by runs 20261030T153252Z-6867 and 20261030T153944Z-1e65 of v1.0.0-rc.2's UAT, and reproduced locally: 15 of 15 first reads after a BE start failed, none of 10 with the fixed provider patched into the jar, none of 4 with one scanner at a time. An IAM user's long-lived key read every time (runs 20261028T120119Z-c93a, 20261028T122104Z-9305 and 20261028T122711Z-4166; 3 of 3 locally), but the release gives StarRocks no long-lived keys

credentials.detail: StarRocks read with read-only S3 credentials of its own, not the catalog's (short-lived session credentials (1 hour) of an IAM role made for the run, allowed only to list and read the warehouse prefix; no long-lived key); the catalog issued it 0 table credentials
credentials.reason: StarRocks does not use the catalog's per-table credentials (design section 7): it reads with read-only S3 credentials of its own, short-lived credentials of a role in the release's UAT (an IAM user's access key in the runs of 2026-10-28). With short-lived ones, its JNI reader's first read of a primary-key table fails, as the pk read limitation says; declared the same here before any serverless run; in the serverless runs of v1.0.0-rc.2 it read with its own credentials too

read.detail: rows: expected 115, got 105; sum: expected 27245, got 26090; uncompacted: expected 10, got 0 (the table holds 2 deletion vector index files, and ids 111..120 uncompacted in 2 level-0 files)
read.reason: StarRocks 4.1.6 bundles Paimon 1.3.1, whose batch scans of a deletion-vector table skip level 0: it does not read the rows still in uncompacted level-0 files (reading them, deletion-vectors.merge-on-read, takes Paimon 2.0); fully compacted tables read correctly. Measured in the EKS form (runs 20261028T120119Z-c93a, 20261028T122104Z-9305, 20261028T122711Z-4166 and 20261028T100928Z-e326); the reader's own, so declared the same here before any serverless run
